title: Identifying High-Confidence Social Biases in LLMs for Trustworthy Conversational Tutoring Agents
reasoning: The paper explicitly incorporates 'hermeneutic uncertainty' (an epistemological concept) into its evaluation framework and discusses the necessity of 'normative judgment' in educational domains like the humanities and social sciences.
